text:
maria: Hey team — new enterprise customer onboarding in APAC needs H100 capacity + private connectivity. They want single-tenant VPCs per environment, NAT egress, and PrivateLink to our control plane. Can we map quota needs and a cost/ops plan?
aj: Thanks — quick list I already sketched: request H100 quota increase in ap-southeast1, increase external IP quota (EIPs) for NAT gateways, bump ENI and private IP limits per subnet, and create Private Service Connect endpoints.
maria: Exact numbers: initial pilot needs 8 H100s, then scale to 32 in production. They'll allocate 3 AZs. Also want reserved pool of 100 public IPs for glue NAT + debugging.
devin: Oof 100 EIPs is high. Cloud provider usually recommends using NAT gateway pooling or egress proxies instead of one-to-one EIPs. What's driving the 100?
maria: Customer wants static IP blocks for allowlisting on their corporate firewall and partner APIs. They also run some on-prem connectors where IP pinning matters.
sophia: Options: 1) Centralized NAT GW per AZ with Elastic IPs (easy, higher $). 2) Egress fleet (autoscaling NAT instances) behind ELB (lower $ but ops overhead). 3) Use egress proxy on Dedicated nodes reusing fewer public IPs via SNAT. Tradeoffs: throughput, failover, cost, and auditability.
aj: For H100s we need quota ticket to cloud: requested cores/GPU quota increase. I propose opening two tickets: compute quota (H100) and VPC external IP quota. I'll draft.
infra-bot: New quota case created: CASE-APAC-2024123 (compute H100), CASE-APAC-2024124 (EIP pool). Estimated response 48-72h.
maria: Also we need subnet sizing plan: each tenant VPC will reserve /22 to allow for ENIs and future scale. Concern: AZ IP exhaustion with 32 GPUs plus worker nodes and infra.
devin: If each GPU node uses 4 ENIs with 30 IPs each (depends on instance type), that burns addresses fast. We should model worst-case: 32 nodes * 4 ENIs * 30 IPs = 3840 IPs. /22 gives 1024 addresses only. So /22 per tenant won't cut it.
sophia: Good catch. Suggest /20 per tenant for headroom (4096 addresses) given their scale and multi-AZ. Also split subnets by function (pods/controlplane/infra) and reserve secondary ranges for managed services.
aj: Routing and peering question: should we do cross-account VPC peering from customer VPCs to our shared egress VPC, or use PrivateLink/PSC? Peering is simpler but becomes messy at scale. PrivateLink gives service-level isolation and simpler audit trails.
maria: They prefer PrivateLink for control plane access. We'll give them PSC endpoints in their VPC and replicate our service endpoints per region. That needs marketplace/service attachment and service network load balancer.
devin: Action items: 1) aj open quota tickets with exact SKU names and region, 2) sophia prepare subnet plan dos/ don'ts, 3) maria align customer on cost tradeoffs, 4) cloudops prepare terraform module for PrivateLink + NAT design.
aj: Draft quota payload I will submit: 
```
Service: Compute Engine / GPUs (ap-southeast1)
Quota delta: +32 H100 GPUs (initial 8, scale to 32)
Justification: Enterprise pilot -> production. High-throughput inference fleet for low-latency inference.
```

And for EIPs: 
```
Service: VPC External IPs
Quota delta: +120 addresses
Justification: static egress IPs for allowlisting across 3 AZs and debugging needs.
```
maria: Please add ENI and private IP quotas too: subnet IPs per region and reserved addresses for managed NAT.
cloudops: I'll prototype an ASG-based egress fleet that reuses 16 public IPs via SNAT and compare cost with 3 AZ NAT GW solution. ETA tomorrow.
sophia: Also need to consider fragmented subnets when we do /20s — we should centralize route tables and keep egress controller in a shared subnet per AZ.
aj: FYI opened support tickets and linked customer sales case: https://crm.example.com/c/CASE-99877. Cloud reply ETA 60h.
maria: Thanks. If cloud approves H100 and EIP quotas, next step is infra change freeze window and CA cert exchange for PSC.
devin: Small operational ask — add healthcheck endpoints and tag all NAT resources with customer ID for billing and tear-down scripts.
sophia: +1. Also plan for fallback policy: if H100 quota delayed we can use a mixed fleet (A100 + quantized models) for first 2 weeks. Lower perf but keeps launch on schedule.
cloudops: Prototype cost numbers: 3 AZ NAT GW (ap-southeast1) ~ $1.8k/month + data fees. Egress fleet (instances) ~ $700/month but ops maintenance ~ 1-2 engineer-hours/week. I'll post detailed calc in the doc.
maria: Great — wrap up: aj to share ticket links, sophia subnet plan, cloudops cost calc, devin tagging + healthchecks. We will present to customer EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
(reacts: :eyes: by aj)
